light_description: Japanese handmade hybrid fuzz using two silicon and one germanium transistor, developed from Organic Sounds' own vintage Buzzaround reference and reworked for usability.
Japanese boutique fuzz based on analysis of a specific vintage Big Muff Rams Head variant, rebuilt with four selected transistor types and a broad low-to-high gain range.
Current Japanese handmade fuzz/distortion with pre/post bass shaping and a MORE gain mode, released in February 2026.
2025 revision of Ovaltone's 2016 FOUNTAIN overdrive, retained as a versioned product state pending generation reconciliation.
2025 Japanese bass overdrive designed specifically for bass, using integrated clean-content control and internal 30V operation for broad drive-to-fuzz range.
Japanese handmade germanium fuzz designed as a controlled fuzz between fuzz and distortion, with adjustable LED brightness and builder-specific voice.
Japanese boutique drive based on Tanabe.TV's DUMKUDO family, documented in current custom configurations alongside SUNKUDO.
Japanese boutique drive in Tanabe.TV's Kudo family, documented in current builder material and custom configurations.
Elusive Japanese boutique upper-octave fuzz based on the Uni-Vox Super Fuzz concept with additional controls and features.
Japanese boutique Muff-family fuzz/distortion from Free Fall Diver's documented range.
Japanese boutique Muff-family fuzz preserved from Free Fall Diver catalog reporting.
Japanese boutique multi-distortion model documented as a Rat-family product in later rarity reporting.
One-person Japanese handmade mini pedal combining a deliberately rough fuzzy distortion voice with a one-knob format; operation paused in late 2017.
One-person Japanese bass overdrive derived from the builder's まほろば concept, with GAIN, TONE and MIX controls and point-to-point construction.
